tpg:casual-real-time.description: Latest-value delivery and public fixed-step simulation helpers support measured small-room prototypes.

tpg:unreliable-messaging.description: Latest-value semantics are emulated over reliable transports; native packet-loss delivery is not available.

tpg:durable-sessions.description: A bounded asynchronous relay reference has revisioned server authority, participant resume credentials, timers, retention, and Cloudflare Durable Object persistence; arbitrary creator-defined durable logic is not yet available.

tpg:camera.description: Published manifests can request camera access; the browser still requires user permission.

tpg:microphone.description: Published manifests can request microphone access; the browser still requires user permission.

tpg:pointer-lock.description: Published manifests can grant pointer lock to game frames.

tpg:fullscreen.description: Published manifests can grant fullscreen to game frames.

tpg:gamepad.description: Published manifests can grant the Gamepad API to game frames.

tpg:webxr.description: WebXR is not granted by the reviewed frame policy.

tpg:downloads.description: Game-initiated downloads are denied by the frame sandbox.

tpg:large-session.description: Rooms above 16 interactive participants are not supported.
